snippet.title: Official Trailer | Dr. Cares - Pet Rescue 911
snippet.description:
So much fur, so many wagging tails! Are you excited about our upcoming GameHouse Original Story game as we are?? ▶︎▶︎▶︎ Play now: http://m.onelink.me/8c43a1c5

Join Amy, freshly graduated from veterinary college and eager to make a difference in the lives of all creatures great and small. But being a vet isn’t always easy and Amy is going to face some pretty big challenges… can you help her decide where she can make the biggest difference?
